retrieval_diagnostics.population: Entire supplied retrieval census in original native order, including duplicate postings, irrelevant/discarded, unresolved and failed lanes
diagnostics: raw noise rate within examined population
missing or rejected known reference cases with reasons
false-negative investigations without relabeling the benchmark output
retrieval_diagnostics.limits: No union-as-market denominator or total-market recall claim; unknown completeness stays unknown. Overlapping term/field counts are not additive.

qualified_recommendations.population: Only evidence-qualified native opportunity recommendations at capture, before any analyst reranking
qualified_recommendations.capture: Snapshot first20 immediately and first100/all if fewer inside predeclared budget; preserve duplicates and native slots; no backfill, replacement rerun or rescue rerank
qualified_recommendations.zero_rule: Zero qualified means zero; unfilled slots stay unfilled. Incomplete/timeout is preserved as incomplete, never scored as zero.

seller_action_quality.per_claim_contract: Each contact, requirement, current event, offering fit, route and ask carries supported/unknown/contradicted status and its own exact evidence references; one supported dimension cannot certify another.
seller_action_quality.count_rule: Report parents, research parents, children, WATCH/HOLD and evidence-qualified seller actions separately. No seller-ready target count or forced quota. No outreach as validation.

prospective_effort.mode: Separately labeled same-brief workflow unless coordinator verifies exact-search semantics
prospective_effort.analyst_clock: Included in the same 60-minute wall window; record active minutes and source/tool actions. No unreported research beyond the cap.
prospective_effort.preparation: Shared hash-locked brief, source policy, known-case list and exclusions prepared prospectively; record preparation time separately and disclose any asymmetric product-specific preparation.
prospective_effort.source_policy: Same permitted public original-source classes and cutoff; preserve attempted/failed/empty/unread source states, exact source/passage authority and source clocks. Disclose different native indexes, features, paid costs, latency and required manual research.
prospective_effort.parity: Unsupported phrase/field/filter/ranking parity yields NOT_COMPARABLE_EXACT_SEARCH. Same-brief workflow results cannot be advertised as identical-query results.
prospective_effort.baseline_effort: Offline investigation and synthetic tests only. No live query clock started; original investigation active time was not instrumented and is not fabricated.
